prompts.master: Edit the FIRST reference image (filename ending '(2).jpeg') into a precise transparent-background hero asset for the FullMuscle FM-GF-001 chest press. The other two references show the same machine from front and side and are ONLY geometry references; do not change the first image's camera. Preserve the identical front three-quarter view, complete silhouette, exact physical construction, placements, dimensions, black steel frame, two green long lever arms, silver perforated foot platform, black seat and tall backrest, grips, and existing FullMuscle label on the front green arm. Remove only the white background and white gaps between all parts to genuine alpha transparency. Add a very subtle neutral studio rim light to black steel edges so they are readable over charcoal, without changing materials or color and without inventing new parts. All components fully assembled. Center the full machine uncropped with modest clear transparent margins; no background, no floor, no cast backdrop shadow, no gradients behind machine, no extra text, no new logo, no decorative elements. Deliver one high-resolution clean isolated product cutout. Faithfulness is much more important than redesign or enhancement.
prompts.colorCorrection: Edit only the color and cutout edge quality of the first image, the transparent cutout. The second image is the original FM-GF-001 reference. Keep ALL geometry, framing, camera, pixel positions, materials and the FullMuscle label exactly unchanged. Change the two currently bright saturated green lever arms to the original muted dark forest green paint, base color #356B35, matching the second original reference. Keep realistic highlights but no neon/lime/fluorescent green, no glowing green outlines. Clean stray green/white speckles outside the silhouette to transparent alpha while preserving smooth antialiased edges and transparent gaps. Maintain the same canvas and placement. Everything else must remain unchanged, no new parts, no background, no shadows outside the machine.
